# Week 4 Start/Sit — Saturday, Oct 3

## Source and freshness

Primary source: the committed **week-4 fixture** (`weekly-report-week-4.json`, generated **2026-09-29 15:53 UTC**, after Week 3's Monday-night finale, with FantasyPros consensus and ESPN injuries). Overlaid with a **live** `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` pull just now: **all 32 teams have filed** for Week 4 (313 rows, the full final Friday designation set, up from 10 rows Wednesday). Checked every rostered player by exact player ID: nobody on this roster carries an Out/Doubtful/Questionable tag. Taylor and Irving are full participants; Bowers is a limited participant (knee) with no game-status tag. **No lineup changes since Wednesday**, but Bowers' outlook is meaningfully de-risked -- see Watch List.

Current week confirmed as **Week 4** via `season_week.py`, cross-checked against the schedule: Thursday's CLE@PIT is final (PIT 27–24); the other 15 games (14 Sunday, 1 Monday) are still ahead.

## Start these ten — 133.19 expected points

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | If he plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | @PHI (Sun 1:00pm) | **15.45** | 16.06 | 96.2% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | @WAS (Sun 9:30am) | **19.33** | 20.57 | 94.0% |
| RB | Cam Skattebo | vs ARI (Sun 1:00pm) | **13.64** | 14.52 | 94.0% |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | vs LAC (Sun 4:25pm) | **20.48** | 21.35 | 95.9% |
| WR | Drake London | @NO (Mon 8:15pm) | **15.49** | 16.15 | 95.9% |
| TE | Brock Bowers | vs KC (Sun 4:25pm) | **12.16** | 15.19 | 80.1% |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins (WR) | vs JAX (Sun 1:00pm) | **13.88** | 14.47 | 95.9% |
| FLEX | Bucky Irving (RB) | vs GB (Sun 1:00pm) | **13.52** | 14.39 | 94.0% |
| K | Cameron Dicker | @SEA (Sun 4:25pm) | **5.39** | 5.49 | 98.1% |
| DEF | Eagles D/ST | vs LAR (Sun 1:00pm) | **3.85** | 3.85 | 100% |

**Bench:** Josh Downs (12.13), Matthew Golden (11.72), Isaiah Likely (10.31), Jameson Williams (10.16), Jaxson Dart (0.02, IR-bound, not for lack of trying).

## Changes

**None since Wednesday's briefing.** Same lineup, same designations. The one real update this run found: Brock Bowers' Weeks 1-3 Out/Doubtful/Questionable trend did not repeat this week -- LV's final Week 4 report has him Limited in practice (knee) but with no game-status tag at all. Start him with more confidence than Wednesday's number implied.

## Watch list

- **Brock Bowers** (Limited practice, knee, no game-status tag) — resolved favorably since Wednesday. Final confirmation is Sunday's inactive list, ~90 minutes before the 4:25pm LV@KC kickoff, but nothing in the final report points the other way.
- **Jaxson Dart** — still a roster-mechanics problem, not a start/sit one. Season-ending knee injury (confirmed RES via roster status), still sitting in the nominal QB slot instead of IR. Flagged in every briefing since 2026-09-23 (five straight) and still unresolved. Bryce Young (CAR, 17.89-pt consensus vs DET) is the top rostered-QB option on waivers right now if the IR move happens.

## Opponent notes

- Skattebo is the only *active* Giants piece in the lineup (NYG vs ARI, Sun 1pm) -- Likely and the inactive Dart are also Giants, but Likely isn't starting, so a bad Giants script this week costs one slot, not two.
- Stafford (LAR) faces our own Eagles D/ST (Sun 1pm) -- a good Eagles defensive day is a bad day for our own starting QB and vice versa. Self-hedging, not actionable.

## Byes ahead

None in Weeks 4–5. **Tee Higgins and Jameson Williams, both Week 6** — now two weeks out. Start planning a waiver claim; only 5 bench spots means a bye cluster needs a plan, not just bench depth.

## Caveats

- No `generate_report.py` run this time — the fixture postdates Week 3's final game, so it's current per the routine's own freshness rule; this is a confirmation pass.
- Tier mix: Stafford/Skattebo/Higgins/Irving/Dicker/Eagles D/ST are the in-house estimate; Taylor/JSN/London/Bowers are FantasyPros consensus. All figures are **expected points** (P(play) × conditional), never the raw if-he-plays number treated as an expectation.
- Live injury overlay matched by exact player ID, not name, across all 32 filed teams -- zero Out/Doubtful/Questionable tags landed on this roster.
- Dart's unresolved IR status is now a five-briefing-old open item; this routine can only flag it, not fix it.
